Anika (People Ops): Quick heads-up — we're kicking off a short compliance sprint for SOC2 + annual privacy attestation. All evidence owners please upload artifacts by Fri Apr 11 23:59 PT. Checklist & templates here: https://redwood.internal/compliance/soc2-2026-checklist :spiral_calendar:
compliance-bot: Reminder: office hours for evidence triage on Wed 11:00 AM PT — sign up: https://cal.link/redwood-compliance-office-hours
Leo (Eng): Quick Q — I'm the evidence owner for model-serving infra. Do we need both config + runtime logs or is one enough?
Maya (Security): Both. Config, runbook, and a 1-paragraph context note + the last 3 months of deploy/log snippets. Screenshots are optional but helpful. Use the infra template.
Jared (Eng): I uploaded KV-cache snapshots but not sure what folder tag to use.
Anika (People Ops): Use the pattern soc2-2026/<team-slug>/<artifact-type>. Example: soc2-2026/model-serving/config.yaml.
Ruby (Design): Does the privacy microlearning still need to be completed by everyone, or only people with data access?
Anika (People Ops): Everyone must complete the 15-min privacy microlearning and submit the attestation. If you have completed it already, add the confirmation link to the evidence repo.
Leo (Eng): If someone is on leave next week, can a manager attest on their behalf?
Anika (People Ops): Yes — managers can file an exception attestation form. Outline the reason & expected return date, then upload to the same folder and CC security.
Jared (Eng): Upload command for artifacts (for folks using gsutil):
```
gsutil cp build/reports/soc2-evidence/*.zip gs://redwood-evidence/soc2-2026/model-serving/
```
Maya (Security): Heads-up: include a short README.txt with the artifact descriptions — that makes triage much faster.
Anika (People Ops): If you hit any blockers, DM me or drop them in this thread. We'll run a final sweep Mon Apr 14 and follow up with owners who still have missing items. :alarm_clock: :thumbsup:
compliance-bot: Uploaded evidence summary (auto): 4 teams complete, 9 teams pending. https://redwood.internal/compliance/summary
Leo (Eng): Thanks — I'll review my team's uploads today.
Maya (Security): Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround.
Anika (People Ops): Thanks everyone — pinging again Wed morning with office hours reminder.
